description: Central Provincial Council - Irrigation Statute of the Central Provincial Council
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the enactment of a provincial statute (Irrigation Statute of the Central Provincial Council No.05 of 2017) that establishes a legal and regulatory framework for irrigation management in the Central Province. It creates a new government department, outlines its functions and powers, establishes committees and authorities, and provides legal provisions for enforcement and penalties. While it mentions a minister's name and title, this is incidental to the main purpose of publishing the new statute, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette rather than a government personnel or hybrid type.
